Roscoe Wayne Marquand (born August 22, 1981) is an American actor. He is best known for his roles in film and television as in the apocalyptic-horror series , alongside voicing numerous characters in the superhero animated series and the in several -related works. In the Pokémon franchise, he voices Hassel in the English-language dub of .
